levels.surface: أبي الجوزاء المنبه بن عبد الله
زيد بن علي بن الحسين بن علي بن أبي طالب

notes: Al-Faqih's statement of his route («فقد رويته عن أبي») to the book of Zayd, with no saying: needs ruling (rule 11).
«فقد رويته عن أبي» names only the father, whose own chain is not written here: not carried as a group.
The last link is Zayd, the author of the cited book (rule 11).
